title: Tuscan Farro Soup
description: A hearty Tuscan-style vegetable and bean soup with farro, tomatoes, herbs, and Parmesan.

steps.instruction: Heat the olive oil in a large deep saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, celery, carrots, a large pinch of salt, and black pepper.
Cook for 5 to 10 minutes until the vegetables soften and become glossy.
Add the minced garlic and stir briefly until fragrant.
Add the farro, soaked white beans, chopped tomatoes, and stock or water.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce heat to maintain a steady simmer.
Cook for about 1 hour, or until the farro and beans are tender, adding more liquid if the soup becomes too thick.
Stir in the parsley and basil if using, then simmer for another 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper if needed.
Serve hot topped with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.
